Origin-quota audit throttling caps fraud audits per origin each epoch. A wharf gate binds each identity's keys to one origin with a base quota of 3 audits per epoch.

A random falcon probe re-checks 10% of filings; a proven-false one forfeits a 0.5-unit escrow and cuts the origin's quota to 1 for 10 epochs. Quotas reset at each epoch's zenith block.

Cost: N origins mass-flagging a peer file at most 3N audits. At N=20, 60 filings with 30% false gives 9 forfeitures burning 4.5 units and 18 origins cut to quota 1, cutting flagging power 70% next epoch.
